biocs.name: Suspicious NTLM authentication with machine account
biocs.description: Detects NTLM authentication attempts using a machine account
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\net.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'net.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious NTLM authentication with machine account
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when a process attempts to authenticate with a machine account over network
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: cmd.exe process initiating network connection to domain controller
